_comment: HYDRA v0.3 example config. Copy to ~/.config/hydra/config.json and edit. CLI flags and HYDRA_* env vars override these values. NEVER put the bearer token in this file. v0.3 adds no new config keys: persistent/detached jobs, system/git endpoints and CDP browser control are requested per-call (browser control is loopback-only by code, not by config; see docs/BROWSER_SETUP.md).
